service: Elastic Load Balancing for Envoy is a fully managed service that runs the open-source Envoy proxy on your behalf. You bring your Envoy configuration, and AWS provisions the proxy, scales it, upgrades the Envoy version, patches the operating system, and monitors its health. The proxy runs on Amazon EC2 instances inside your own virtual private cloud (VPC), so you keep full control of your network, security groups, and IAM.

operations.AssociateCertificate: Associates an ACM certificate with the specified Proxy.
operations.CreateProxy: Creates a proxy. A proxy is a fully managed, Envoy-based proxy that runs your Envoy configuration on Amazon EC2 instances inside your own virtual private cloud (VPC). AWS provisions and scales the proxy, upgrades the Envoy version, patches the operating system, and monitors its health.
operations.DisassociateCertificate: Disassociates an ACM certificate from the specified proxy.
operations.GetProxyAttributes: Retrieves the attributes for the specified proxy.
operations.GetProxyConfigurationContents: Retrieves the configuration file, the configuration archive, or both for the specified proxy. This operation is separate from GetProxy so that you can grant access to proxy metadata without granting access to the configuration content.
operations.GetProxyUpdate: Retrieves information about the specified proxy update.
operations.ListCertificateAssociations: Lists the ACM certificate associations for the specified proxy.
operations.ListProxies: Lists the proxies owned by the caller account.
operations.ListProxyUpdates: Lists the updates for the specified proxy, most recently submitted first.
operations.ListTagsForResource: Lists the tags for the specified resource.
operations.TagResource: Adds the specified tags to the specified resource.
operations.UntagResource: Removes the specified tags from the specified resource.
operations.UpdateProxyAttributes: Updates the attributes for the specified proxy.
operations.UpdateProxyConfiguration: Updates the configuration for the specified proxy. You can update the configuration file, the configuration archive, or both.
operations.UpdateProxyNetworkConfiguration: Updates the network configuration for the specified proxy.
